source_signature.notes: Batch 4C skill 3/5. Scope per Architect E3: integral method only — R = integral w(x) dx, line of action from the first-moment integral. Composite-area decomposition explicitly deferred to distributed_load_resultant_by_centroid (skill 4/5). Worked example independently re-derived by Operator: w(x) = 2 + x^2/4 kN/m on [0, 6]; R = [2x + x^3/12] from 0 to 6 = 12 + 18 = 30 kN; M = [x^2 + x^4/16] from 0 to 6 = 36 + 81 = 117 kN-m; x_bar = 117/30 = 3.9 m. Load is asymmetric (w(0)=2, w(6)=11 kN/m), so x_bar > L/2 as physically expected. First worked example REPLACED at the review beat: the original w(x) = x(6-x) was symmetric, making x_bar = 3.0 m obtainable by the centroid_symmetry shortcut and rewarding the exact L/2 assumption that sign_or_placement_error@6 exists to catch. 2-signal mapping content-earned: sign_or_placement_error at step 6 (line-of-action computation), unclassified at step 8 (final reporting and sanity check). axis_confusion omitted: all work is along a single beam-axis coordinate, no step resolves components. simple_average_used omitted: Centroids-family signal, no averaging step exists in the integral method. Method-escape errors (uniform wL, area-by-inspection, composite decomposition) are covered in common_errors and intentionally carry no signal rather than being attached to a step where they do not occur.
